html:
G'oya

Bo'lim maoshlarini o'sish tartibida raqamlaymiz va o'rtadagi bir yoki ikki qatorni olamiz. Bo'limda cnt xodim bo'lsa, o'rtadagilar (cnt + 1) / 2 va (cnt + 2) / 2 raqamli qatorlar (bo'lish butun). Toq cnt da bu ikki son bir xil, juftida qo'shni. Qolgani tanlangan qatorlarning AVG i.

Yechim

WITH r AS (
  SELECT department, salary,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY salary, id) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS cnt
  FROM employees
)
SELECT department, AVG(salary) AS median_salary
FROM r
WHERE rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2)
GROUP BY department

cnt = 3 da ikkala son 2, cnt = 4 da 2 va 3. Namunada IT'da 5000, 7000, 9000, mediana 7000. Sotuvda 3000, 4000, 6000, 8000, mediana (4000 + 6000) / 2 = 5000.

ROW_NUMBER teng maoshlarga ham har xil raqam beradi, bizga shu kerak: 100, 100, 100, 700 da ikkinchi va uchinchi qator 100, mediana ham 100.

Tuzoqlar

O'rtacha maosh mediana emas. Yuqoridagi 100, 100, 100, 700 misolida AVG 250 beradi.

Juft bo'limda faqat bitta o'rta qatorni olish ham xato. O'rtachani SUM(salary) / COUNT(*) bilan hisoblash esa nozikroq xato: butun sonlar bo'linganda kasr tashlanadi va 300 bilan 301 ning medianasi 300.5 o'rniga 300 chiqadi:

Noto'g'riWITH r AS (
  SELECT department, salary,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY salary, id) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS cnt
  FROM employees
)
SELECT department, SUM(salary) / COUNT(*) AS median_salary
FROM r
WHERE rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2)
GROUP BY department

AVG esa kasrni saqlaydi.

Dialektlar farqi

PostgreSQL'da mediana uchun tayyor funksiya bor, SQLite'da yo'q:

Faqat PostgreSQLSELECT department,
       PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY salary) AS median_salary
FROM employees
GROUP BY department
